archiveNote103: Records saved on this computer by company, user and mode. Official lookup requires the same operator and device on the server.
change103: Second closing change against the first
invalid103: Invalid data or date range. No values were used.
salesNote103: Read only. Values and statuses come from the sale record and do not prove bank settlement.
incomplete103: List incomplete or unavailable. Use a sale reference to look it up; this list is not the till total.
selectedCash103: The sale must belong to the selected till.
receiptNote103: Sale record receipt. It does not replace a fiscal document or bank confirmation.
namesNote103: Original product names are not included. Items use their order and reference without looking up current prices.
queueNote103: Requests saved on this computer. Local approval does not mean a refund, withdrawal or adjustment was executed. Decide in the corresponding operation area.
queryEmpty103: Enter a reference to look up.
